purpose: Possible final symmetric end pull after successful threading; this does not demonstrate tying, grasp retention or task success.

method.interpolation: Cartesian smoothstep and rotation slerp, warm-started NumPy IK
method.collision_checks: Every commanded pose: all opposite-arm collision-link OBBs, refined to per-collision-mesh OBBs where aggregate bounds overlap; nonbase-link table envelopes.

path.action: Rotate both hands at their staging TCPs to the listed final rotations
Simultaneously pull at x=0.24 m, z=0.94 m, mirroring the listed positive y coordinates
Hold the final pose closed; actual qualifying span must persist for at least one second before release
Open both hands in place to finger joint -0.04695 m
Hold final poses open while the cord releases and settles; do not command the rejected vertical withdrawal

ideal_span_arithmetic.qualification: Arithmetic only: use the actual scorer span lower bound, suspension and timing; neither tail projection nor a knot is simulated.

limitations: Transition from the future threading pose into these staging poses is not audited.
No rope/contact, grasp retention, force, dynamics, topology or scoring success is demonstrated.
Within-arm self-collision, other scene fixtures and between-command motion are not independently certified.
Do not extend the pull beyond the audited targets or treat ideal tip arithmetic as measured span.
